name: FireRed Tilesheet Importer Prototype
description: Experimental Red-only, tilesheet-first FireRed visual importer with an evidence-backed 8x8 target-slot ledger. It preserves existing Gen 1 map grids, block definitions, and gameplay semantics while generating local visual sheets from a verified FireRed source.
